title: You'll wait a year. You won't wait a day.

scenes.say: A year from now, you'd happily wait for more. On the day itself, you grab the smaller amount.
Hyperbolic discounting: we discount rewards brutally when they're close, gently when they're far.
{small} dollars sooner, or {large} dollars {gap} months later.
scenes.note: Model: hyperbolic discounting V = A/(1 + kD), k = {k} per month

scenes.say: Seen from far away, the bigger reward feels like {later_large}, beating {later_small}.
Right before the day, {small} now feels like {now_small}, against {now_large}. You grab it.
Decide when the reward is far away, then lock it so present-you can't undo it.

takeaway: Decide when the reward is far away, then lock it so present-you can't undo it.
